final_session.cross_check: mask stats read 33 invoices from the public Preview indexer; mask receipt returned true for the shielded payment receipt; mask attestation returned true for the digest; the Verify page, in a fresh browser with no wallet, found the attestation and two receipts and reported a made-up digest as not found
final_session.bug_found_and_fixed: With a real wallet the payer address inside refund and payment codes was the bech32 coin public key; the decoder requires hex, so refunds and revenue proofs would have failed for every Lace user. The app now writes the hex form.
